exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Not so much / Not that".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! そんなに～ matches "Not so much / Not that".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is そんなに～.
exercises.explanation: Used to say something is not as much or not to that extent.
